approved_command_preview: On exact PR #427 head, strengthen the combined-release self-test so the human WebUI Markdown is proven to stay synchronized with JSON runtime_model and capability states as well as the already-tested Name, Description, starters, Instructions, and Knowledge order; run focused and full agent-runtime validation, commit and push only the PR branch.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$branch = 'issue-426-human-first-openai-gpt-packages'
$expectedHead = 'f3e25de42ba9cca9656562df8258458b3b341655'
$worktree = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'pr427-capability-sync-test'
function Invoke-Logged([string[]]$GitArgs) { Write-Host "git $($GitArgs -join ' ')"; $output = & git @GitArgs; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($output) { $output | Out-Host }; if ($code -ne 0) { throw "git failed with exit $code`: git $($GitArgs -join ' ')" } }
Invoke-Logged @('fetch','--no-tags','origin',"refs/heads/$branch`:refs/remotes/origin/$branch")
$remoteHead = (& git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$branch").Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $remoteHead -ne $expectedHead) { throw "Branch head guard failed: expected $expectedHead got $remoteHead" }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $worktree) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $worktree -Recurse -Force }
Invoke-Logged @('worktree','add','--detach',$worktree,"refs/remotes/origin/$branch")
$entered = $false
try {
  Push-Location $worktree; $entered = $true
  $path = 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release_selftest.py'
  $text = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw
  $oldCapabilities = '        "capabilities": {},'
  $newCapabilities = '        "capabilities": {"web_search": False, "image_generation": True},'
  $count = ([regex]::Matches($text, [regex]::Escape($oldCapabilities))).Count
  if ($count -ne 1) { throw "Expected one synthetic capabilities fixture, found $count" }
  $text = $text.Replace($oldCapabilities, $newCapabilities)
  $oldAssertions = @'
        assert config["description"] in handoff
        for starter in config["conversation_starters"]:
            assert starter in handoff
'@
  $newAssertions = @'
        assert config["description"] in handoff
        assert f"`{config['runtime_model']}`" in handoff
        for capability, enabled in config["capabilities"].items():
            label = module.CAPABILITY_LABELS.get(capability, capability.replace("_", " " ).title())
            state = "ON" if enabled is True else "OFF" if enabled is False else "UNSPECIFIED"
            assert f"- {label}: **{state}**" in handoff
        for starter in config["conversation_starters"]:
            assert starter in handoff
'@
  $count2 = ([regex]::Matches($text, [regex]::Escape($oldAssertions))).Count
  if ($count2 -ne 1) { throw "Expected one human-handoff assertion block, found $count2" }
  $text = $text.Replace($oldAssertions, $newAssertions)
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $path -Value $text -NoNewline -Encoding utf8
  python -m py_compile $path
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'py_compile failed' }
  python $path
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'combined deployment release selftest failed' }
  $commands = @(
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/validate_shared_agent_source_contract.py'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/validate_shared_agent_source_contract_selftest.py'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/materialize_agent_behavior_adapters.py','--check'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/materialize_agent_behavior_adapters_selftest.py'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/project_agent_knowledge.py','--check'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/project_agent_knowledge_selftest.py'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_dcoir_analyst.py','--check'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_dcoir_analyst_selftest.py'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_usb_reporting.py','--check'),
    @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_usb_reporting_selftest.py')
  )
  foreach ($cmd in $commands) { python @cmd; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Governed agent-runtime command failed: python $($cmd -join ' ')" } }
  Invoke-Logged @('diff','--check')
  $changed = @(& git status --porcelain | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring(3) }); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git status failed' }
  if ($changed.Count -ne 1 -or $changed[0] -ne $path) { throw "Unexpected changed paths: $($changed -join ', ')" }
  Invoke-Logged @('config','user.name','github-actions[bot]')
  Invoke-Logged @('config','user.email','41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com')
  Invoke-Logged @('add','--',$path)
  Invoke-Logged @('commit','-m','Test OpenAI WebUI runtime and capability sync')
  $newHead = (& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Unable to read new PR head' }
  Invoke-Logged @('push','origin',"HEAD:refs/heads/$branch")
  Write-Host "Updated PR branch head: $newHead"
  $dirty = @(& git status --porcelain); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'final git status failed' }; if ($dirty.Count -ne 0) { throw "Worktree is not clean after push: $($dirty -join '; ')" }
}
finally {
  if ($entered) { Pop-Location }
  & git worktree remove --force $worktree 2>$null
  & git worktree prune
}
